image_description: A close-up shot of a small, white mustelid (likely an ermine or stoat in winter coat) peeking out from a crevice between reddish-brown rock and yellowish lichen-covered stone. The animal has pure white fur, small dark eyes, a pink nose, and visible whiskers. The background is softly blurred.

Two distinct, small, dark, round eyes are visible and symmetrically placed.
Both ears are visible, short, and rounded, consistent with weasel anatomy.
